subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted gateway disconnects keep the current recook-first behavior but isolate the local fallback in a fresh session, or should this PR wait for a reattach-first design?
rationale: The patch fixes the same-session collision, but accepted disconnects still can execute twice and possibly deliver twice; automation cannot choose the product semantics for this fallback boundary.

options.title: Land narrow fresh-session fix
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for now, merge the same-session collision fix, and track reattach-first behavior separately.

options.title: Expand into reattach-first
options.body: Ask the author to change this PR to wait for the accepted gateway run before using fresh-session embedded fallback as last resort.

options.title: Pause until direction is decided
options.body: Hold or close this PR if maintainers do not want to bless recook-first behavior for accepted disconnects.

recommendation.title: Land narrow fresh-session fix
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for now, merge the same-session collision fix, and track reattach-first behavior separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent agent CLI/gateway fallback history most directly points to this area owner for the fallback behavior tradeoff.
